title: Range queries fail on runtime fields

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

labels.name: Team:Search Foundations
labels.description: Meta label for the Search Foundations team in Elasticsearch

body:
Range queries currently fail on runtime fields with a `NullPointerException` when not both lower and upper bound are specified:

```
java.lang.NullPointerException: null
	at java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(Objects.java:222) ~[?:?]
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.runtimefields.mapper.KeywordScriptFieldType.rangeQuery(KeywordScriptFieldType.java:142) ~[?:?]
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.runtimefields.mapper.AbstractScriptFieldType.rangeQuery(AbstractScriptFieldType.java:113) ~[?:?]
	at org.elasticsearch.index.query.RangeQueryBuilder.doToQuery(RangeQueryBuilder.java:514) ~[elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.index.query.AbstractQueryBuilder.toQuery(AbstractQueryBuilder.java:103) ~[elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.index.query.SearchExecutionContext.lambda$toQuery$3(SearchExecutionContext.java:466) ~[elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.index.query.SearchExecutionContext.toQuery(SearchExecutionContext.java:478) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.index.query.SearchExecutionContext.toQuery(SearchExecutionContext.java:465) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.search.SearchService.parseSource(SearchService.java:912) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.search.SearchService.createContext(SearchService.java:750) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.search.SearchService.executeQueryPhase(SearchService.java:438) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.search.SearchService$2.lambda$onResponse$0(SearchService.java:406) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.action.ActionRunnable.lambda$supply$0(ActionRunnable.java:58) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.action.ActionRunnable$2.doRun(ActionRunnable.java:73) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.common.util.concurrent.AbstractRunnable.run(AbstractRunnable.java:37) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.common.util.concurrent.TimedRunnable.doRun(TimedRunnable.java:44) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.common.util.concurrent.ThreadContext$ContextPreservingAbstractRunnable.doRun(ThreadContext.java:739) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at org.elasticsearch.common.util.concurrent.AbstractRunnable.run(AbstractRunnable.java:37) [elasticsearch-8.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:8.0.0-SNAPSHOT]
	at java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.runWorker(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:1130) [?:?]
	at java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor$Worker.run(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:630) [?:?]
	at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:832) [?:?]
```

Regular range queries have no such limitation, and can specify either a lower or an upper bound, not requiring both.
